description: This file defines a shell function 'preinit_set_mac_address' that sets MAC addresses for network interfaces based on the specific board type. It uses external scripts and system commands to retrieve and assign MAC addresses during system pre-initialization.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets MAC addresses for network interfaces based on the detected board type, using different sources for MAC addresses depending on the hardware.

calls: ip link set dev eth0 address
ip link set dev eth1 address
